description: Labeled messages for the extraction routing gate. `label` is what the gate must do: `extract` means the claim extraction must not be skipped, `skip` means it may be. `kind` names what is at stake — a durable fact, a correction, a constraint, chatter, or an assistant echo of a known fact — so a recall figure exists per kind. `context` is the known-entities block the gate sees, as extraction would build it from the graph.
